## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Security impact

Explain any effect on path containment, approval, stale-write detection, mutation/recovery, rollback, snapshots, or audit behavior. Write `None` if there is no security impact.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run check` passes
- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] New or changed security behavior has regression coverage
- [ ] Documentation is updated when public behavior changes
- [ ] The change stays within the scope described in `SCOPE.md`
